title: P6 Maths (PSLE)
description: Primary 6 / PSLE Mathematics (Singapore MOE 2021 syllabus, 2026 exam format): fractions, ratio and before-after problems, percentage, angles, circles, volume, data, algebra. Name-the-method heuristics, low-pressure sessions, statistically targeted practice.
